name: Split Benchmark
concept: The Benchmark with its two Recovers split. Block gets frame advantage when it beats a Pressure (you win any speed duel next round) instead of a follow-up; Dodge keeps the follow-up but costs 2 grey on your own pile if it's beaten.
notes: Added 30 Oct 2026 to test the Block/Dodge split (rules-overview 15, Open Question 2). In the scratch sim (Benchmark mirror, 600 games): Block 14-15% of plays, Dodge 18-20%; a Pressure-only bot beat Hard 7-8% of the time; quiet rounds 23%.
